ref.substituent_description: Quinoline with NH (N with H below) at C2, linking to a benzene that has Me ortho to the NH-bearing carbon, and C(=O)NHBn at C4.
ref.notes: Typeset. 9 double bonds: 5 in the quinoline, 3 in the tolyl ring and 1 C=O.

wrong.substituent_description: Quinoline (Kekule lines) with NH (N with H below) at C2, linking to a benzene (circle) that has CH3 ortho to the NH-bearing carbon. C(=O)-NH-CH2-phenyl (phenyl drawn as a circled benzene) sits at C3, the carbon next to C2, not at C4.
wrong.notes: Handwritten in dark grey/graphite (counted as black). Quinoline double bonds: 2 in the benzo ring and 3 in the pyridine ring, plus 1 C=O.

correct.substituent_description: Benzene (circle) with NH on one carbon and Me on the adjacent (ortho) carbon. The NH is bonded to C2 of a quinoline, the carbon next to the ring N; C(=O)NHBn is at C4, the carbon next to the ring-fusion carbon.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The ring N label is slightly detached from the C2 bond line
The pyridine ring is drawn with a circle while the fused benzo ring has two explicit double-bond lines (mixed depiction)
correct.notes: Handwritten. NH written inline (not stacked). Double bonds: 2 inner lines in the benzo ring plus C=O.

errors_in_wrong.description: In the reference the C(=O)NHBn carboxamide is at quinoline C4, next to the ring-fusion carbon. In the wrong drawing the carboxamide is at C3, the carbon adjacent to the NH-bearing C2.
The reference label NHBn is expanded in the wrong drawing to NH-CH2 with a fully drawn phenyl ring.
The reference label Me on the tolyl ring (ortho to NH) is written as CH3 in the wrong drawing.

review_notes: Wrong drawing: the carboxamide is at quinoline C3 instead of C4, and Me/NHBn are expanded to CH3 and CH2-phenyl. The corrected drawing restores C4, Me and NHBn. It mixes a circle (pyridine ring) with two Kekule lines (benzo ring) in the quinoline. That still reads as aromatic and was not counted as an error. Transcriber_2's 'wrong' transcription describes an unrelated molecule and was ignored.
